title: Why Lunar Ice Is Mars' Only Fuel Source (2026)
description:
Most people think we launch fuel from Earth. That math doesn't work for Mars. This short explains how water ice in the lunar south pole shadows becomes liquid oxygen and hydrogen for the return trip.

We break down the electrolysis process and why this single resource changes the economics of deep space travel. No hype, just the physics that makes interplanetary travel possible.

#SpaceScience #MarsMission #LunarIce #Propellant #Astronomy
